title: Firearm #5 Malibu Comics Ultraverse (1994) Bogdanave & Breyfogle Malibu Comics
descriptionText: The product is a vintage single issue comic book from January 1994 titled "Firearm #5" from the Ultraverse series by Malibu Comics. Written by James Robinson and featuring artwork by Bogdanove & Breyfogle, this color comic book is part of the Modern Age era of US Comics and falls under the genre of Superheroes. The story focuses on the character Firearm within the Ultraverse universe, making it a collectible item for fans of comic books and graphic novels.
